name: git
description: Repo change tracker for the mod protocol: tracks ALL changes in the mod repo (status, per-file diffs, commits, ahead/behind) and any other local or GitHub repos you point it at. Search all of GitHub for repos through its search API and track or fork any hit. Push a commit without writing the message: the agent module reads the pending diff and proposes one, and this module finalizes it — stage, commit, push — behind its own ACL and over your GitHub account. Connect GitHub by OAuth (device or redirect flow) or a PAT — the account is attached to your mod key and stored off-chain in ~/.mod/git — to list/track/push private repos, and manage per-address write/admin access with signed auth-module tokens.
